sources.snippet: Silly Kicks Comic by NanoBanana — inspired by Monty Python's Ministry of Silly Walks The Ministry requires that all football actions be properly classified and valued. silly-kicks is a Python library for objectively quantifying the impact of individual actions performed by football players using event stream data.
